notes.title: Update 7.0.0 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538342/aa5aaa9f3e43f0b4881885149e3cb46d976c84e6.png[/img]

[h1]Content:[/h1]
[h3][list]
[*] Full gamepad support is now available
[*] Feel free to play with either mouse and keyboard or just the gamepad
[*] All interactions have been updated to Xbox and PlayStation buttons
[*] All menus have been updated to allow gamepad selection
[*] Text message now has key binding available
[*] Jump key now has key binding available
[*] Controller sensitivity has been added similar to mouse sensitivity
[*] Minor adjustments in characters for hotel and club levels
[/list]
[/h3]
